<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XXVI.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|77 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=26|verse=48}}† And he that betrayed him, gaue them a signe, saying, Whomsoeuer I shal kisse, that is he, hold him. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=49}}† And forthvvith comming to IESVS, he said, Haile Rabbi. And he kissed him. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=50}}† And IESVS said to him, Freend, vvhereto art thou come? Then they drevve neere, and laid hands on IESVS, and held him. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=51}}† And behold one of them that vvere vvith IESVS, stretching forth his hand, drevve out his svvord: and striking the seruant of the high Priest, cut of his eare. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=52}}† Then IESVS saith to him, Returne thy sword into his place: for al that take the svvord, shal perish vvith the sword. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=53}}† Thinkest thou that I cannot aske my Father: and he vvil giue me presently more then tvvelue legions of Angels? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=54}}† How then shal the scriptures be fulfilled, that so it must be done? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=55}}† In that houre IESVS said to the multitudes: You are come out as it vvere to a theefe vvith swordes and clubbes to apprehend me: I sate daily vvith you teaching in the temple: and you laid no hands on me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=56}}† And al this vvas done, that the scriptures of the Prophets might be fulfilled. Then the disciples al leauing him, fled.

{{verse|chapter=26|verse=57}}† But they taking hold of IESVS, led him to Caiphas the high Priest, vvhere the Scribes and auncients vvere assembled. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=58}}† And Peter folovved him a farre of, euen to the court of the high Priest. And going in he sate vvith the seruants, that he might see the end. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=59}}† And the cheefe Priestes and the vvhole Councel sought false vvitnes against IESVS, that they might put him to death: {{verse|chapter=26|verse=60}}† and they found not, vvhereas many false witnesses had come in. And last of al there came tvvo false vvitnesses: {{verse|chapter=26|verse=61}}† and they said, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 2, 19.''}}* This man said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and after three dayes to reedifie it. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=62}}† And the high Priest rising vp, said to him: Ansvverest thou nothing to the things vvhich these do testifie against thee? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=63}}† But IESVS held his peace. And the high Priest said to him: I adiure thee by the liuing God, that thou tel vs if thou be Christ the sonne of God. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=64}}† IESVS saith to him, Thou hast said. neuertheles I say to you, hereafter you shal see {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Dan. 7, 13.''}}* the Sonne of man sitting on the right hand of the povver of God, and comming in the cloudes of heauen. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=65}}† Then the high Priest rent his garments, saying, He hath blasphemed, vvhat neede vve witnesses any further? behold, novv you haue heard the blasphemie, {{verse|chapter=26|verse=66}}† hovv thinke you? But they ansvvering said, He is guilty of death. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=67}}† Then did they spit on his face, and buffeted him, and other smote his<noinclude>{{rh||K iij|face}}</noinclude>
